jobs.title: Product Manager (Mid-Senior Level)
jobs.description:
At Neighbor, we’re building the largest hyperlocal marketplace the world has ever seen. We’ve raised over $75 million from top-tier investors such as Andreessen Horowitz and the CEOs of DoorDash, StockX, and Uber. Our marketplace is already flourishing in all 50 states and we’re just getting started!
 
As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for setting the vision, defining the strategy, and driving the execution of a meaningful part of our marketplace. You will pioneer a standard of customer obsession, analytical rigor, and AI-augmented velocity that makes Neighbor fundamentally better for our hosts and renters across all 50 states.

A Typical Day
- Ship product and deliver measurable impact, fast

- Lead cross-functional groups to execute against company objectives

- Communicate concisely and influence outcomes across all levels

- Develop product roadmaps and build alignment across teams, cross-functional partners, and the executive team

- Define and analyze the metrics that signal product success and health

- Advocate for the customer with a deep understanding of their needs

- Weigh the cost/benefit of maintaining product features vs. building new ones

- Own the answers to product questions — prioritization, status, and the "why" behind decisions
About You
- 2+ years of experience as a product manager or in a similar role

- Experience with consumer internet products or marketplaces is a plus

- AI power user — you use tools like Claude, Cursor, and similar daily to accelerate research, spec writing, prototyping, and decision-making

- Proficient in using data to inform decisions and uncover business opportunities

- Strong verbal, written, and visual presentation skills

- Comfort with a dynamic, fast-growing, flat culture

- Able to drive problem and solution discovery with minimal supervision

- Able to quickly absorb complex concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience
Benefits
- Stock options

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Generous PTO

- 11 paid company holidays

- 401(k) plan

- Infant care leave

- On-site gym/showers open 24/7
About Neighbor:
Neighbor is the largest and most comprehensive marketplace for self storage and parking, with listings in almost every U.S. city. From storage facilities to neighborhood garages, driveways, and RV spots, Neighbor brings every option together in one simple search. Come help us disrupt the $500 billion storage and parking industry! This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing, VC-backed tech startup. You will be part of a an extremely talented, hardworking and passionate team committed to changing the world one neighbor at a time.
 
Neighbor is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, connect with us via email at hr@neighbor.com. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Neighbor!
